installCommand: if grep -q '"name": "ai-assistant"' package.json 2>/dev/null; then ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 npm install; else cd apps/03_ai-assistant && ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 npm install; fi
buildCommand: ROOT="$PWD"; if grep -q '"name": "ai-assistant"' package.json 2>/dev/null; then APP="$ROOT"; else APP="$ROOT/apps/03_ai-assistant"; fi; cd "$APP" && npm run build:web && if [ "$APP" != "$ROOT" ]; then rm -rf "$ROOT/dist-web" && cp -r "$APP/dist-web" "$ROOT/dist-web"; fi
